description: As your US Senator, I will ask, repeatedly, can we solve this problem with less government? For a while, we were a nation that believed government was the problem, not the solution. It’s why our founding fathers decentralized power across three branches. We were a nation that believed government should move slowly, intentionally, toward making things better for people. We understood the responsibility for caring for one another, for securing the means of our own prosperity, and protecting children and the elderly fell on our community. Then Ronald Reagan asked, during his 1980 campaign, “Are you better off now than you were four years ago?”
title: Why Less Government is Better - Kasie South Carolina
